name: Cboe Global Markets
outlook:
What Cboe Global Markets says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted operating expensesAdjusted operating expenses 2 in 2026 are expected to be in the range of $830 to $845 million, down from prior guidance of $838 to $853 million.
  • Full year 2026: effective tax rate on adjusted earningsReaffirms the effective tax rate on adjusted earnings 2 for the full year 2026 is expected to be in the range of 27.5 to 29.5 percent.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresReaffirms capital expenditures for 2026 are expected to be in the range of $98 to $108 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
